about: A flute for the last refrain of Jingle Bells' felt piano (version 8, after 7c: "one more colour of instrument"), written by Composer's Assistant 2 hearing the piano and 7c's strings, each as its own instrument: bars 52-67, one note at a time, starting about twice a bar, mostly by step, loosely between A4 and C6, under the tune an octave up where it can.
